scope_summary: Static audit of 173 migrations + 79 Eloquent models for soft-delete usage, FK cascade declarations, forceDelete callsites, Schema::drop migrations, and NF525 cascade safety.
method: code-static only (grep + Read on migrations/models/services). No DB runtime exercise.

verdict_justification: Zero NF525 cascade reachability — audit_logs and z_reports have no FK from any parent, are protected by 2-layer (model+DB-trigger) immutability, and their down() migrations refuse to run in production. Hard delete of Order/Branch/User is blocked end-to-end by RESTRICT chains + DELETE triggers on order_payments/cash_movements/cash_drawer_sessions. The single forceDelete callsite (ItemService) is properly guarded by historical-reference check + transaction. Three minor GDPR/cloud-prep items deferred to V1.0.2 backlog (loyalty cascade asymmetry, z_reports/orders down() guard symmetry, Sanctum token prune cron). Frozen-zone diff = 0 (audit-only, no code modified).
